positions.name: Sprint4DeliveryDrivers
positions.why: The three expressions cohere around Sprint 4 delivery: the async decision widget shipped (src-1) and velocity hit a quarterly high of 23 points (src-2), with the Zephyr integration identified as the key unlock (src-3) that explains both outcomes. The frame reads src-3 as the causal driver behind the results recorded in src-1 and src-2.
